foundation: A Decoder activates exactly one output line corresponding to the binary value of the address inputs A1 A0 using NOT (7404) and AND (7408) gates.
optimization: In Stage 2, replacing AND/NOT gates with NAND gates (7400) produces active-low output lines (0 active).
industrial: In Stage 3, build the 2-to-4 Decoder using NOR gates (7402) for active-high decoding logic.
